name: How much does a whole-home renovation cost in Pasadena or Los Angeles in 2026?

mainEntity.name: How much should I budget for a whole-home renovation in Pasadena or Los Angeles if I want mid-range or luxury finishes?
mainEntity.text: How much should I budget for a whole-home renovation in Pasadena or Los Angeles if I want mid-range or luxury finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a whole-home renovation in Pasadena or Los Angeles, budget planning should start with the home’s square footage, the amount of structural work, and the finish level you want. Current published ranges show many major remodels starting around the mid-six figures for full-home projects, while high-end gut renovations can move far beyond that when the scope includes new kitchens, bathrooms, floors, windows, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and layout changes. Luxury projects often cost much more per square foot because they require custom millwork, premium fixtures, upgraded surfaces, and more design coordination. The biggest budget drivers are wall removal, old-house system upgrades, permit complexity, and long-lead materials. A good budget should also include contingency funds for hidden issues such as rot, outdated wiring, or damaged framing once walls are opened. Homeowners comparing bids should ask each contractor what is excluded, because allowances and finish assumptions can make one estimate look cheaper than another. In older Los Angeles-area homes, discovery work often changes the final number.
acceptedAnswer.description: Whole-home renovation budgets in Pasadena and Los Angeles vary widely by size, finish level, and scope, but current published ranges commonly land from about $150,000 to $400,000+ for major remodels, with high-end gut renovations reaching $450,000 or more. Per-square-foot pricing rises sharply when structural changes and full system upgrades are included.
